description: High DDI pair with Normal renal function
ref_rationale: Independent flags: High DDI requires monitoring review; preserved CrCl (98.6) does not trigger renal dose review

description: High DDI pair with Severe renal impairment
ref_rationale: Independent flags: Severe CrCl (15.5) triggers renal dose review alongside High DDI monitoring review

description: Moderate DDI pair (Phenytoin+Digoxin) with Normal renal function
ref_rationale: Moderate pair must trigger monitoring review and never issue false reassurance (Standard Regimen Maintained)

description: Moderate DDI pair (Gentamicin+Digoxin) with Normal renal function
ref_rationale: Moderate pair (Alkadi 2004 PMID 15085946) must trigger monitoring review under Normal CrCl (90.5)

description: Confirmed negative-search DDI pair with Moderate renal impairment
ref_rationale: No pair interaction found in dated search; CrCl 38.9 (Moderate) requires renal dose review

description: Single renally cleared drug with Severe renal impairment
ref_rationale: No pair to check; Severe CrCl (15.5) requires renal dose review

description: Vancomycin+Digoxin PETINIA specimen artifact with Normal renal function
ref_rationale: Must classify Tang et al. 2022 (PMID 35541501) as assay/specimen limitation (interaction_found=NO and monitoring_review=YES)

description: Vancomycin+Digoxin PETINIA specimen artifact with Severe renal impairment
ref_rationale: Must report renal dose review (CrCl 20.6) + assay limitation monitoring without misclassifying pair as pharmacologic DDI

description: Three-drug regimen combining High DDI pair and PETINIA artifact pair
ref_rationale: Must separate pharmacologic DDI pairs (Vanco+Gent High and Gent+Dig Moderate) from Vanco+Dig analytical interference

description: Hepatic impairment documented with single drug and Normal renal function
ref_rationale: Hepatic flag is caution-only (out of calculation scope) and must NOT set dose_review=True

description: Hepatic impairment documented with negative-search pair and Normal renal function
ref_rationale: Hepatic flag + negative search must output CAUTION NOTED without announcing a calculated dose adjustment

description: Negative-search pair with Normal renal function and no hepatic impairment
ref_rationale: Must state no flags from checks performed and label pair as NOT PROOF OF SAFETY

description: Drug pair outside the 6-pair sourced knowledge base
ref_rationale: Out-of-KB pair must return INSUFFICIENT INFORMATION (not_in_knowledge_base) and never negative interaction

description: Unknown hepatic impairment status in patient intake/CSV
ref_rationale: Unknown hepatic status must be preserved as None -> INSUFFICIENT INFORMATION and never silently coerced to False

description: Paediatric patient (age 10 years Bauer Ch.10 Ex.2) submitted to adult pipeline
ref_rationale: Must reject age < 18 before Cockcroft-Gault or adult Michaelis-Menten constants are applied

description: Non-finite NaN serum creatinine submitted to renal/batch validator
ref_rationale: Must reject NaN serum creatinine rather than allowing NaN comparisons to slip past <= 0 checks

description: Non-numeric height submitted in batch CSV row
ref_rationale: Batch validator must catch non-numeric height_cm before grouping

description: Two CSV rows for same patient_id with conflicting ages (50 vs 60)
ref_rationale: Batch validator must quarantine inconsistent demographics for the same patient_id before grouping

description: Standalone TDM helper called with NaN measured concentration
ref_rationale: interpret_tdm must return status=indeterminate on NaN (never within range)

description: Standalone TDM helper called without measurement_type or matching unit
ref_rationale: interpret_tdm must return status=indeterminate when measurement_type is omitted or unit mismatches mg*h/L
